using Makie

function makeplot(x, y)
    fig = Figure(size=(800, 360))
    
    # Left plot: Red line
    ax_left = Axis(fig[1, 1], title="Raw", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Value")
    ax_left.plot!(x, y, color=:red)
    
    # Right plot: Green scatter of abs(y)
    ax_right = Axis(fig[2, 1], title="Absolute", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Value")
    ax_right.scatter!(x, abs.(y), color=:green)
    
    # Link y-axes
    linkyaxes(ax_left, ax_right)
    
    return fig, ax_left, ax_right
end
